query:
SELECT
             (SELECT count(*) FROM kb_blob_uploads WHERE owner_profile_id = $1)::bigint
               AS "open!",
             COALESCE((
               SELECT SUM(octet_length(s.bytes))
                 FROM kb_blob_upload_segments s
                 JOIN kb_blob_uploads u ON u.id = s.upload_id
                WHERE u.owner_profile_id = $1
             ), 0)::bigint AS "staged!"
